# FG-GIT-0006

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `output_over_cap_is_git_output_too_large` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: Git の処理結果が大きすぎるため中断しました。
- en: The Git operation produced too much output and was stopped.
- id: Operasi Git menghasilkan keluaran terlalu besar dan dihentikan.

## 原因 (cause)

A captured (non-streaming) git invocation wrote more stdout than `GitConfig::max_output_bytes`; the child was killed. Large data (blobs, packs) must use the streaming path.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `subcommand` and `max_output_bytes`. Find the caller from the span chain: a captured call on unbounded data is a bug to fix with streaming or a limit.

## 対処 (fix)

Move the caller to streaming, or bound what it asks git for (e.g. `--max-count`).
